meta.name: consolidate
meta.description: Audit and prune rules/skills/learnings to prevent context bloat. Triggers "consolidate", "clean up rules", "spa day", "what's redundant", degraded agent perf.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计并清理冗余规则与技能，防止上下文膨胀
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 agent 经常因上下文过大导致响应变慢
copy.tagline_en: Audit and prune redundant rules and skills to prevent context bloat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent often responds slowly due to context bloat

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计并修剪规则、技能和学习记录，防止上下文过大。它会统计数量、检查矛盾、合并重复项、简化 CLAUDE.md，最后输出一份整理报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“consolidate”、“clean up rules”、“spa day”等关键词，或检测到代理性能下降时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理一下规则和技能。
say.note: Claude 会审计并合并重复项，输出报告。

say.text: 检查是否有冗余的学习记录。
say.note: Claude 会清理过期或重复的记忆条目。
Claude 会简化 CLAUDE.md 并整理技能触发词。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits and prunes rules, skills, and learnings to prevent context bloat. It counts items, checks for contradictions, merges duplicates, simplifies CLAUDE.md, and outputs a consolidation report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "consolidate", "clean up rules", "spa day", or when degraded agent performance is detected.

say_en.text: Tidy up my rules and skills.
say_en.note: Claude audits and merges duplicates, then outputs a report.
Claude removes outdated or duplicate memory items.
Claude simplifies CLAUDE.md and reorganizes skill triggers.
